STEC risk depends on strain, infectious dose, food or animal source, hygiene, setting, age and clinical vulnerability.
STEC evidence is strain-, exposure-, case-, setting- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Botulism risk depends on toxin type, food or drug source, wound conditions, dose, route, clinical timing and treatment access.

Diphtheria risk depends on toxigenic strain, respiratory or skin presentation, contact intensity, immunity, setting and response timing.

Polio risk depends on virus type, immunity, travel or environmental exposure, sanitation, surveillance and contact context.
